title: refactoring / Extensions with refactorings
content:
## Extensions with refactorings You can find extensions that support refactoring by looking in the {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} [Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/vscode). You can go to the Extensions view (`kb(workbench.view.extensions)`) and type 'refactor' in the search box. You can then sort by install count or ratings to see which extensions are popular.
> **Tip**: The extensions shown above are dynamically queried. Select an extension tile above to read the description and reviews to decide which extension is best for you.
